evals.name: sourdough-book
evals.prompt: compile everything you can find about sourdough bread baking, i want to write a beginners guide book from it
evals.expected_output: Project folder with scope/facets, 30+ rated sources of many types, cited compendium chapters, overview with best sources by type, bibliography, book workbench (outline, keep/cut)

evals.name: fasting-decision
evals.prompt: Gather all the resources on intermittent fasting research. I'm a nutrition coach and need to decide whether to recommend it to my clients (mostly women 35-55).
evals.expected_output: Project folder with evidence-heavy compendium focused on women 35-55, safety, options matrix / recommendation workbench, 30+ sources incl. reviews and RCTs
